verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents self-hosting on your own infrastructure and has an official, dedicated Docker Compose deployment guide under its self-hosting/platform docs. However, the evidence shows no guides for Kubernetes/Helm, small VPS, or Raspberry Pi, so only one of the four named targets is shown to have a maintained path. Missing for 10: Kubernetes/Helm guide, VPS-specific guide, Raspberry Pi/ARM guide, evidence of guide maintenance, independent hands-on corroboration of the Docker Compose path.
